name: BluePrint Engines
old_description: Since 1982, BluePrint has delivered more than engines—we’ve delivered engineering excellence. From thrill riders to families, we share a passion for the road that unites us all. Every custom crate engine is as unique as a fingerprint—beautiful, powerful, dyno-tested, and backed by unmatched warranty and support. Led by Norris Marshall, our relentless engineers prove that skill and authenticity make us the authority in crate engines.
about:
BluePrint Engines operates from Kearney, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1982. The company is led by Norris Marshall and has built its reputation on custom crate engines for performance automotive applications.

The manufacturer produces crate engines compatible with GM, Ford, and Chrysler platforms, along with dedicated motorsports lines for drag racing, drift, circle track, and off-road use. Each engine undergoes in-house dyno testing using an advanced computerized balancer that brings rotating assemblies within two grams, and a dyno-generated printout of horsepower and torque accompanies every unit. The facility also stocks engine components covering air and fuel delivery, cooling, ignition and electrical, and oils and fluids.

Customers include automotive enthusiasts, professional racers, and engine builders across the performance aftermarket. The company serves the drag racing, drifting, circle track, and off-road segments, supplying complete crate engines and replacement parts for both street and competition applications.

BluePrint Engines emphasizes engineering excellence and authenticity, positioning itself as an authority in crate engine manufacturing. The business was started to deliver dyno-verified, warranty-backed engines that eliminate speculation about real-world output, a philosophy that continues to drive its testing and documentation practices.
